mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rent_payment ( payment_id, rent_product_id, buyer_name, seller_name, price, duration_type, start_at, end_at, status ) VALUES ( #{paymentId}, #{rentProductId}, #{buyerName}, #{sellerName}, #{price}, #{durationType}, #{startAt}, #{endAt}, #{status} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM rent_payment WHERE buyer_name = #{buyerName} ORDER BY start_at DESC
SELECT NVL(SUM(price), 0) FROM rent_payment WHERE seller_name = #{sellerName} AND TO_CHAR(start_at, 'YYYY-MM') = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM')
SELECT NVL(SUM(price), 0) FROM rent_payment WHERE buyer_name = #{buyerName} AND TO_CHAR(start_at, 'YYYY-MM') = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM')
